# addendum_v1.golden.json and its generator are superseded by finality_chain1

`addendum_v1.golden.json` (with `addendum_v1_golden_generator.py`) was produced for the first framework (bf1e5d8) and never
merged to main. It stays in the tree unchanged: a golden is specification and is never re-baselined, moved or deleted
(00_STANDARD.md section 3). It is **not** the golden of the current rules, because V2_SPEC_S7 r2 changed three of them:

| old golden | V2_SPEC_S7 r2 |
|---|---|
| the chain commits to the "original proof digest" (`fb01a7d2...`), carried inside the file | D0 is the leg binding `SHA-256(lp("certen:finality:d0/v1") ‖ lp(be64 chain) ‖ lp(be64 number) ‖ lp(blockHash))`, recomputed by the verifier from the Settlement it verified and never read from the file (section 2.6) |
| seq 1 is level `included` | level 1 (`included`) is derived and never stored; stored levels are `l1_posted` (2) and `finalized` (3), in any order, at most one addendum each (sections 1.2, 2.1, 2.3) |
| evidence is the container `be32(1) ‖ lp(kind) ‖ be64 number ‖ hash ‖ txHash ‖ lp(body)` | evidence is the CFE1 container `"CFE1" ‖ STR kind ‖ u64 chain ‖ u8 level ‖ u64 number ‖ B32 hash ‖ body` (section 3.1) |

What still holds, and is still asserted by `TestSupersededGoldenStillReproducesUnderTheUnchangedPreimageLayout`: the
`ownHash` preimage layout (`lp(domain) ‖ lp(d0) ‖ lp(prevHash) ‖ lp(be64 seq) ‖ lp(u8 level) ‖ lp(be64 chain) ‖ lp(kind) ‖
lp(sha256(evidence))`) is unchanged, so the three `ownHash` values of this file still reproduce when its "original digest" is
read as the D0 input. The chain it describes is, however, refused by the current `VerifyChain` (level 1, container shape).

The goldens of the current rules are in `finality_chain1/`: `goldens.json` pins G0 (`ownHash 0fa89474...9539` over the 187-byte
preimage) and G1 (`D0 1cea0a36...3445` over the 85-byte preimage, `ownHash 27b59e3b...cdc7`), computed independently with
Python `hashlib` and node `crypto` (V2_SPEC_S7 2.2). `MANIFEST.json` lists the sha256 of every file and
`MANIFEST.json.sha256` the sha256 of the manifest. The set is generated by `pkg/finality/vectorgen`
(`go run ./pkg/finality/vectorgen -out pkg/finality/testdata/finality_chain1`) and reproduced byte for byte by
`TestTheGeneratorReproducesTheCommittedSetByteForByte`. New evidence gets a new set (`finality_chain2`), never an edit.

# finality_chain1: thirteen expectations superseded by finality_chain2 (RB11-B2B1)

`finality_chain1/` stays byte-identical (a vector set is specification and is never re-baselined). `finality_chain2/` re-issues every
vector of chain1's `chains.json`, `containers.json`, `codec_probe.json` and `table.json` in the same order with the same members, and
changes exactly the `expect` of the thirteen vectors below, for one of two reasons. Everything else in chain1 holds as written;
`TestChain2ReissuesChain1VectorForVectorChangingOnlyTheSupersededExpectations` and
`TestTheChain1SupersessionIsExactlyTheMessageTextExpectations` fail if any other expectation moves. The chain1 Go tests judge the
thirteen through `supersededExpect` (the same list), so the chain1 files remain consumed.

**(a) Ten message-text expectations: the `reason` of a state was a Go sentence a TypeScript port would have had to copy verbatim.**
Every `reason` is now a member of a CLOSED set recorded in `testdata/finality/states.json` (`enums.reason`), and the vectors pin the token.

| chain1 vector | old `reason` | new `reason` |
|---|---|---|
| chains.json `kind_level1_refused` (finality_addendum_malformed, field level) | `level "included" is derived and never stored (stored levels: l1_posted, finalized)` | `level_not_stored` |
| containers.json `header_level_0`, `header_level_1`, `header_level_4` | `only levels l1_posted (2) and finalized (3) are carried; included is derived` | `level_not_stored` |
| containers.json `header_kind_has_nul` | `a STR is ASCII with no NUL` | `str_not_ascii_or_nul` |
| codec_probe.json `probe_trailing_byte` | `trailing bytes` | `trailing_bytes` |
| codec_probe.json `probe_nodes_descending`, `probe_nodes_duplicate` | `nodes are not strictly ascending by keccak256 and unique` | `nodes_not_ascending_unique` |
| codec_probe.json `probe_count_exceeds_remaining` | `count exceeds the remaining bytes` | `count_exceeds_remaining` |
| table.json (chain 84532, level 1) | `included (1) is derived and never stored; only l1_posted (2) and finalized (3) have kinds` | `level_not_stored` |

**(b) Three byte-value expectations: since V2_SPEC_S7 r2 (V-C1A) every `[]byte` and every fixed byte array (`[4]byte`, `[32]byte`) renders as
`0x`-prefixed lower-case hex in the canonical form, the empty byte string as `0x`.** Removing every `0x` from the new text gives the old text.

| chain1 vector | change |
|---|---|
| chains.json `leg_binding_altered_leg_member` | `got.blockHash` and `want.blockHash` gain `0x` |
| containers.json `header_l3` | `blockHash` gains `0x`; `body` `424f4459` becomes `0x424f4459` |
| containers.json `header_l2_empty_body` | `blockHash` gains `0x`; `body` `""` becomes `"0x"` |

`goldens.json` of chain1 (G0, G1) is unchanged and remains the golden of the hash preimages; chain2 has no goldens of its own and its
`MANIFEST.json` records the sha256 of chain1's manifest and of `testdata/finality/states.json`.
